statement:
∀ (p k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 1 ≤ k →
  ∀ (N : ZMod (p^k)) (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p^k)),
    max p χ.conductor ≠ max p ψ.conductor →
      (∑ x : (ZMod (p^k))ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod (p^k))) * ψ (N - (x : ZMod (p^k)))) = 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0008 · 排除不同活跃导子层之间的反射项
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0008 · Eliminate reflection entries between distinct active conductor layers

brief.zh: 用模 p^j 的平均作正交投影，选择一个只使两特征之一通过的 j。导子 1 和 p 放在同一最低块，因此冻结结论只区分 max(p,导子)。
brief.en: Use the average modulo p^j as an orthogonal projector and choose j so exactly one character passes. Conductors 1 and p share the bottom block, so the statement distinguishes max(p,conductor).
